debug_api: window.SUNSET.state() and window.SUNSET.game (player, playerCar, cars, peds, policeCars, enemies, wanted, health, world, setWanted, teleport, startMission, giveCash)

files.game/src/actors.js: Traffic, parked cars, peds, police, guards, collisions
files.game/src/audio.js: WebAudio synth (engine, sirens, punches) — fully guarded
files.game/src/game.js: Game factory: state machine, driving, wanted, combat, respray, save/load
files.game/src/main.js: three.js boot, input, HUD, minimap, camera, window.SUNSET API
files.game/src/world.js: Grid, roads, buildings, landmarks, traffic lights, day/night

how_to_run: Open game/index.html in a browser (file:// works, no server needed). Deterministic run: game/index.html?seed=1337&lowfx=1

missions.brief: Steal a car and take it to Sunset Garage
missions.name: First Ride

missions.brief: Take a car to the Docks, pick up the crew (2), then drive them to the Safehouse with 2 stars
missions.name: Crew Pickup

missions.brief: Pick up the package at the Docks and deliver it to Bay Mall within a 90-second timer
missions.name: Hot Delivery

missions.brief: Beat down the two casino guards, steal the gold car, and drive it to the garage
missions.name: Repo Man

missions.brief: Rob the Palm Casino vault (stay in the zone 8s), then escape to the Safehouse with 3 stars
missions.name: The Sunset Heist

systems.combat: Punch deals 34 damage (3 punches down a ped or guard, hp 100); guards do not raise wanted; peds do.
systems.economy: Start $250. Mission payouts m1 $300, m2 $600, m3 $500, m4 $800 (net +$650 if a respray fires on arrival), m5 $2500.
systems.police: Wanted level 1-5; each star spawns a police car that chases, holds at ~7 m and rams; wanted >= 2 adds foot police on foot. Busted on foot (fine $200) or wasted (fine $100); respawn at the Safehouse.
systems.rendering: three.js r160 vendored offline (game/vendor/three.module.js). No CDN, no network. ?seed=1337 deterministic, ?lowfx=1 low effects.
systems.respray: $150 at Sunset Garage clears wanted (5 s cooldown).
systems.save: localStorage key sunset-bay-save-v1 (cash, health, completed missions, position); Continue button after reload.
systems.traffic: 10 traffic cars following the road grid with red-light stops and car-ahead braking; 24 pedestrians; parked cars off the road.
systems.traffic_lights: Junction lights cycle every 14 game-seconds; running a red raises wanted by 1 with a toast.
systems.wanted: Raised by stealing, punching peds, running red lights, hitting peds with a car, and mission heat. Decays 1 star per 45 game-seconds with no crime and no police near.
systems.world: 9x9 street grid (roads every 52 m), landmarks: Palm Casino (104,104), Bay Mall (-104,0), Docks (-156,-156), Safehouse (156,156), Sunset Garage (-156,104). Day/night cycle.

tagline: Cole Vance is back in town with $250 and two fixers who owe him work. Steal cars, dodge the cops, run five missions — and pull the Sunset Heist.
title: SUNSET BAY
